item.title: Boshengya Recalls Rugs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Carpets and Rugs
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from September 2026 through October 2026 for between $30 and $65.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from September 2026 through October 2026 for between $30 and $65.
item.summary: This recall involves Boshengya-branded rugs. The pink or orange shag area rugs measure about 5 or 6 feet wide and 8 feet long. ‘INCREDIBLY SOFT’ is printed on a label on the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Boshengya Shag Area Rugs.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the rugs immediately and contact Boshengya for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the rug by cutting it in half and send a photo of the destroyed rug to boshengya666@outlook.com. Consumers will then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
